attributes.action: Raise the tuition fee limit for home undergraduate students
attributes.additional_details:
Due to the international students paying 3 to 4 times a home student would, they are more likely to be chosen over home students with better grades,better personal statements. 

This is not the Universities faults due to Univerisities having to pay a comfortable wage for leading professors, facilities and research.

The majority of the limited amount of space sshould not be spent on international students who will return after their education back to their home countries and not contribute here.
attributes.background: The UK has recently seen an insanely large increase in foreign students with worse grades being chosen over UK students who have achieved quite high grades. This has led to many qualified students being unable to get into their dream universities or sectors since universities need more funding.

rejection.details:
It's not clear what you're asking the UK Government or Parliament to do.

The Government has already increased the maximum tuition fees for undergraduate students in England and announced further increases.

We're not sure how much you want the tuition fee limit to be increased by, or whether you want the Government to take action to change how universities offer places to home and international students.

You can find out more here:
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/tuition-fees-and-student-support-2026-to-2027-academic-year
